loreLimits: Texture utilitaire originale de planches navales, sans prétention de reproduire un navire nommé.

assets.prompt: Generate one production PNG texture for the horizontal playable ground strip of a 2D painted fighting game stage, wooden wrecked ship deck. OPAQUE 1536x512 requested, very wide 3:1 rectangle. The ENTIRE image is the same continuous weathered dark brown salt-worn wooden deck planks, from all four edges to all four edges. Shallow front-lateral orthographic view, horizontal parallel plank seams and consistent scale, NO trapezoid perspective, NO vanishing point, NO horizon, NO sky, NO ship railing, NO sea, NO scenery, NO characters, NO props, NO holes, NO torn silhouette, NO text. Planks are structurally intact, worn grooves, restrained nail heads, desaturated cold teal reflected light and warm aged wood grain, hand-painted detailed 2D game texture. Usable walkable strip, no large obstacles, no black borders or transparency, no fake sheet/grid. Make wood occupy every pixel with subtle lighting even at edges. Not a photograph.
assets.visualNotes: Planches horizontales couvrant réellement les quatre bords, perspective parallèle sans trapèze, matière sombre et usée adaptée au pont d'épave. Aucune scène ni obstacle incorporés.
